  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  February 13, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on February 13, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera , Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Crystal McGover, Emergency Service / Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on January 23, 2025.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Daniel Medina on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a 2025 Black History Celebration
  Event, Downtown Inglewood on Market Street, from regent to Hillcrest Blvd, on Saturday,
  February 22, 2025, Public Property, from 11:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual
  business license and tax fees; Business owner must possess and maintain valid and
  current Los Angeles County Health Department Permit;Current California Safe Body Art
  Act AB300 & Cal-OSHA Compliant of Bloodborne Pathogens (BBP) Training for Tattoo
  Artists, Body Piercer, Permanent Make-Up, and Micro blading Professionals; Business
  owner shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of
  applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department;Parties, social events or gatherings of any type
  is strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including
  cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises;No massage of any part of the body is
  not permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any
  Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance;Adhere to all State, Federal, County and
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to

Permit(s):
Item #2:  Jeffrey King on behalf of Rolling Loud to host a Rolling Loud Event at 1001 Stadium Dr. on
  Saturday, March 15, 2025, Private Property, from 1:00 p.m. -11:00 p.m and Sunday, March
  16, 2025 , from 1:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Police & TCO staffing TDB and finalized by the special
  events unit; Approval for 2 day event within SOFI stadium parking lot; Applicant to submit
  a Noise Mitigation Plan to the City; applicant to pay five hundred thousand ($500,000) for
  business license fee and one hundred dollar deposit ($100,000) for each even day; Revised
  Noise Mitigation Plan approved by Code Enforcement;Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00404946)

Permit(s):
Item #3:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Women Rock Empowerment Summit
  Event, at 111 N. Locust St, on Saturday, May 03, 2025, Public Property, from 9:00 a.m. -
  2:00 p.m. Approval for 1 day event within Inglewood Senior Center.IPD will Staff officers
  will be staffed at this event for public safety; two (2) City Hall security officers will assis for
  public safety and safety of employees working this event; IPD watch commander will be
  notified and extra patrol provided as time permits. Maintain site at all times, ensuring site
  is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00404928)

Item #6:  George Fernandez DBA droopy’s Tattoo Shop to operate as a Tatto Shop at 4233 W. century

  for Tattoo Artists, Body Piercer, Permanent Make-Up, and Micro blading Professionals;
  Business owner shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies

  strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including
  cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises;SUP2400003;No massage of any part of
  the body is not permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement

  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation

  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384977)

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):

Item #8:  Ken’s Liquor & Deli to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 8400 8th Ave.This Business
  License has been APPROVED with the following condition set forth by the Permits
  and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC),
  specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN
  THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all State and Federal Rules and
  Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet of total retail floor areaSales or
  display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored
  Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes;
  Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless Tobacco Products,
  Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco
  rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly Prohibited;Sales of
  tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly
  prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have a valid
  government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display of any type
 Permits & License Committee  February 13, 2025
Minutes  Page 5 of 6

  of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees
  are subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the
  day or night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections
  is to enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated
  cannabis products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic
  paraphernalia per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics,
  this would also include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to
  smoke / ingest illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and
  employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police
  related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or
  response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance,
  Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.);Applicant and employees are expected to be active
  participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that
  may necessitate a police response or response from other city government services (i.e.
  Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); andThe following
  is not allowed inside the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee
  review and permit: PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND,
  MUSIC BOXES (juke box), NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S)
  PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC. APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE
  BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR NIGHT) OF OPERATION.
